title: A generalized monoid of infinite words: asymptotic prefix-suffix quotients and algebraic structure
summary: A generalized monoid of words tilde{Sigma}* is constructed as the quotient of moderate nets of finite words by an asymptotic equivalence relation based on a bidirectional prefix-suffix metric. The main algebraic result is that this quotient is a monoid containing Sigma* faithfully, with a reversal involution, a natural divisibility preorder, failure of cancellation, and nontrivial idempotents.
